notes: Vanilla Assassination at 60 does not have Envenom or a real Mutilate rotation -- those are later-expansion redesigns. The Forever talent tree adds a talent-granted Mutilate (spell 1310707, rank 1, sim/rogue/mutilate.go) and a Venom finisher (1310703, sim/rogue/venom.go) to this tree, named here as the intended combo-point builder ahead of Sinister Strike, and as an alternate finisher choice ahead of Eviscerate. Both are now implemented (rotation-accuracy program, 2026-09-28): a rogue who has spent the talent point casts them; a bare-build rogue who has not falls through to the vanilla Sinister Strike / Eviscerate loop underneath exactly as before, since the engine simply doesn't register the spell without the talent. Cold Blood is popped right before the finisher for a guaranteed crit. Every rank named here is checked against this build's own spellconst.

expected_idle.reason: once Mutilate is talented, Venom (entry 2, spellId 1310703, condition currentComboPoints >= 5) sits ahead of this line in the priority list and claims the finisher slot every time (notes on entry 2: 'a talented rogue spends 5 combo points here instead of on Eviscerate below'), by design from an earlier fix round -- the ladder's level 50/60 rungs have the Mutilate talent, so this line never gets a combo point once Venom is live.

Slice and Dice shares Eviscerate's own five-combo-point floor and Eviscerate (or, once talented, Venom) claims the combo points whenever both are ready in the same instant (this line's own notes, from an earlier fix round); once Venom is talented at level 50/60 it wins that race every time, so Slice and Dice is never reached -- a real DPS cost of the current priority order, not something this diagnosis pass redesigns.

spellranks.json models Mutilate as a four-rank progression (ids 1329/1310707, 399956, 1241582, 1241584 at levels 40/30, 40, 50, 60), but sim/rogue/mutilate.go's own doc comment says it is Forever-only, single-rank, talent-gated (node 105709), spell 1310707 only, with no learnable ranks of its own -- the rewrite's rank-4 resolution (1241584) at level 60 is a spellranks.json data-pipeline defect, not a rotation gate; flagged for the data lane rather than fixed here.

priorityList.notes: Cold Blood right before the finisher for a guaranteed crit -- the Assassination burst button, since the spec has no Adrenaline Rush. Does not spend combo points, so it is safe to check ahead of the finishers below regardless of which one ends up spending them.

Venom as an alternate finisher the Forever Assassination tree grants (sim/rogue/venom.go): a talented rogue spends 5 combo points here instead of on Eviscerate below, for the poison damage/proc-chance buff; an untalented rogue has no Venom spell registered and falls through to Eviscerate.

Eviscerate at five combo points: the functional finisher while Venom is not yet implemented. Checked ahead of Slice and Dice's refresh so a full five-point finisher is never given up in favor of a refresh. Was starved entirely: Slice and Dice used to sit ahead of this line instead, re-applying itself at currentComboPoints >= 1 with no floor, so it looped at 1-3 combo points forever and this line never saw five.

Slice and Dice: only ever spend combo points on it once there are five banked, and only when it actually needs it -- down entirely, or under 3s remaining. Kept at the same five-combo-point floor as Eviscerate above so combo points are never spent below five on either finisher; Eviscerate above claims the combo points whenever both are ready in the same instant.

Mutilate as the Forever Assassination talent's intended combo-point builder (sim/rogue/mutilate.go): a talented rogue strikes with both weapons here for 2 combo points; an untalented rogue has no Mutilate spell registered and falls through to Sinister Strike.
Sinister Strike as the combo point builder for a rogue without the Mutilate talent.
